<img src="images/KevinWong_Headshot.jpg" alt="Kevin H. Wong" class="home-photo">

::: {.home-about-text}
Hello! I'm **Kevin H. Wong**, an Assistant Scientist at the University of Miami Rosenstiel School of Marine, Atmospheric, and Earth Science. My research uses bulk and single-cell molecular approaches, genomics and bioinformatics to understand how marine invertebrates respond to climate change stressors.

This notebook is where I share my work: lab work, analyses, roadblocks, fixes and finished workflows. I believe science is best served by transparent, reproducible work, so everything here is open. Questions or suggestions? Email [kevinhwong1@gmail.com](mailto:kevinhwong1@gmail.com) or visit my [website](https://sites.google.com/view/kevin-h-wong/home/).
:::
:::

## How this notebook is organized

- **[Notebook](notebook.qmd)**: dated entries of what I did and what happened: lab work, analyses and troubleshooting.
- **[Pipelines](pipelines/index.qmd)**: complete computational workflows, maintained in place with a changelog.
- **[Wet Lab Protocols](protocols/index.qmd)**: step-by-step bench protocols, each linked to the notebook entries that used it.
- **[Projects](projects.qmd)**: notebook entries grouped by research project.

The notebook links to GitHub repositories with more detail. *Built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org); originally built with Jekyll Now (Barry Clark) and material from many open lab notebooks. Thanks to all.*
